mail.robin.text: Hello @,^I've seen you do a lot for the community!^I drafted a blueprint for an improved quest board. It lets you check special orders directly from home.^It needs some gold for the antenna though!^^   - Robin %item craftingRecipe Zebrus_Gold_Quest_Board %%
mail.qi.text: Congratulations. You have found things hidden to others.^I have been watching your talent for a long time.^Here is a blueprint to help you work even more efficiently. Do not disappoint me.^^   - Mr. Qi %item craftingRecipe Zebrus_Iridium_Quest_Board %%
mail.raccoon.text: Hello neighbor!^I saw you took care of that old stump. That inspired me!^Here is a little blueprint for a statue that helps you keep an eye on the furry residents.^^   - A friend %item craftingRecipe Zebrus_Raccoon_Statue %%
mail.fish.text: Ahoy!^Congratulations on your new Fish Pond! Fish can be demanding creatures.^To save you from checking on them every day, I designed this sensor. Good luck!^^   - Willy %item craftingRecipe Zebrus_Fish_Statue %%

mail.aushilfskraft.text: Hello! Thank you for your first aid efforts in town. As a small thank you for your hard work, here is a bonus. Keep it up!^^- Mayor Lewis
mail.stuetze_der_gesellschaft.text: You've become an indispensable part of our town. People speak highly of your reliability. Here is your well-deserved premium.^^- Mayor Lewis
mail.auftrags_veteran.text: One hundred completed orders! That is an incredible achievement. Your tireless work has noticeably improved life in our community. Please accept this as a token of our gratitude.^^- Mayor Lewis
mail.uebererfueller.text: Pulling off a special order in just one day... not bad! I always thought I was the only one in the valley who could work at this pace. Here's a little energy boost for your next shift.^^- Robin
mail.geldregen.text: You've built up quite a fortune through your orders. Someone with your business sense surely knows how to turn this into even more profit!^^- Pierre
mail.wochenend_schicht.text: Anyone who works through the weekend until the very last minute desperately needs some relief. Let this machine take over some of your daily work on the farm!^^- Marnie
mail.dorf_pendler.text: It's nice to see that your helpfulness doesn't stop at the town borders. The residents of Ridgeside Village greatly appreciate your dedication!^^- Lenny
mail.pfad_des_ninjas.text: You have entered the secret path and accepted your first ninja assignment. Continue to prove yourself worthy.^^- Jio
mail.ridgeside_stammgast.text: You are seen in Ridgeside more often than some locals these days! Your tireless dedication to our village does not go unnoticed.^^- Lenny
mail.informations_monopol.text: You've built quite an impressive communication network on your farm! Anyone who does this much carpentry surely has a use for this premium building material.^^- Robin
